newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Sonae seen hitting 5,000 esc high end-96.
newsitem.headline: Sonae seen hitting 5,000 esc high end-96.

text.p: Shares in Portuguese industrial group Sonae Investimentos could reach an all-time high of 5,000 escudos by the end of this year as investors anticipate the advantages of a reorganisation of the group, dealers said.
"If investors are not afraid, a historic high of 5,000 escudos could be reached by the end of the year," said Paulo Guerreiro of Lisbon broker M.Valores.
Sonae hit a high for 1996 of 4,744 escudos on Lisbon bourse on Tuesday before easing back to close at 4,719 escudos, up 29, in volume of 89,770 shares.

Sonae has announced a reorganisation under which the holding company would keep the retail and real estate activities and a new company, Inparsa-Industria, would incorporate wood products, media, construction and other activities.
Analysts said the reorganisation made the activities of the group more transparent and was welcomed by foreign investors.
Several brokers have made buy recommendations for Sonae based on optimism over its profit growth prospects.
"5,000 escudos by year-end is a reasonably sustainable level," said Joao Vermelho of Central de Investimentos.
He estimated an average profit growth of 25 percent per year for Sonae Investimentos over the next two years.
Jose Freire of ESR-Espirito Santo Research said: "Sonae Investimentos stock will reach 5,000 escudos by the end of the year, due to the reorganisation."

ESR forecast that Sonae would end this year with a net profit, without extraordinaries, of around eight billion escudos, down from 12.9 billion in 1995, which included 8.3 billion in extraordinary results.
It forecast that Sonae's profits would grow to 11 billion escudos without extraordinaries in 1997.

Sonae Investimentos has forecast that it would end the year with a consolidated net profit after minority interests of 13.9 billion escudos. But excluding extraordinary results, the profit was expected to grow 80 percent to 8.3 billion escudos.
